claims.claim: Get the ultimate gaming experience with this PlayStation 4 Pro.
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows two PS4-style controllers on a box labeled 'STAR WARS' and 'PS4'; no PS4 Pro console is shown or confirmed.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-original/compatible clones rather than genuine DualShock 4 units.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the controller back label/markings (model/part number) and any Sony branding/serial text; also show the ports and exact button/LED layout clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a worst-case compatible/clone bundle (lower than genuine), assuming unknown quality.

risks.risk: Stick drift or worn analog sticks (common issue) affecting gameplay.
risks.proof: Video clip of both controllers in a PS4 input test (showing analog stick movement returning to center) or a screen recording of calibration results.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed for drift-free operation.

risks.risk: Button/trigger wear or non-responsive buttons (triangle/circle/cross/square, L1/R1, triggers).
risks.proof: Video clip pressing every button/trigger with on-screen button indicators (or a controller test app) for both controllers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing repair/with reduced functionality.

risks.risk: Cable damage or poor connection (coiled/straight cables shown, but condition not verified).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing cable ends/strain reliefs clearly, plus a test where the controller is connected and recognized without disconnects.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case with possible cable/connectivity issues.

risks.risk: Controllers may not pair/are not recognized by a PS4 (or only one works).
risks.proof: Video clip showing both controllers pairing/being recognized on the PS4 (two controllers listed) and working in-game or in the controller test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: one controller may be faulty or not working.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete bundle (only controllers and cables are confirmed visible).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (all accessories) and a clear shot of the box contents list/what’s inside.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers + visible cables only, with no extra accessories assumed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of each controller’s back label/model/part number and any Sony branding (to confirm original vs clone).
Video showing both controllers connected/paired to a PS4 and recognized (two controllers visible).
Video of controller test/calibration showing analog sticks centered (no drift) for both controllers.
Video pressing all face buttons and triggers with on-screen indicators for both controllers.
Close-up photos of cable ends/ports and a clip showing stable connection (no disconnects).
Photo of all items included in the box (everything laid out) to confirm completeness.
response.reason: A PS4 Pro console is not shown in the witness report, and key pricing drivers (original vs clone, drift/response, pairing/working status, and completeness) are not verifiable from the provided observations. Proof is needed before a reliable worst-case price can be set.
